title: Bounded application receive delivery quantum verification
scope: Verify independently forceable legacy_current and single_segment receive_delivery_quantum values, exact one-read-call semantics, bounded observation and unified provenance, exact sample-scoped raw joins, authoritative safety fallback, terminal and cancellation behavior, unchanged receive-credit authority, and force-legacy rollback without making a performance or active-behavior claim.
verification_method: Canonical SpecTrace validation, deterministic requirement-home tests, schema and semantic validation, and focused stream-state, application-read, terminal, cancellation, package, flow-control, and ownership correctness tests.
preconditions: receive_credit_publication and every adjacent applied policy remain legacy_current.
The stopped 55,658-epoch single-axis transform remains diagnostic_incomplete and untouched.
Performance measurement, campaigns, transforms, ML, CI work, push, active_internal, and production activation remain unauthorized.
procedure: Validate the Stage 3 specification, architecture, work item, and verification artifacts against the canonical model and reciprocal links.
Build the affected runtime, test project, and raw host in Release before testing.
Verify closed legacy_current and single_segment values plus invalid closed-set rejection.
Verify disabled, observe-only, shadow, forced-legacy, and forced-single-segment modes with all identities, source, reason, safety, latch, fallback, and version fields distinct.
Verify legacy_current drains every contiguous receive source segment that fits and single_segment stops after the first productive source segment.
Verify the decision occurs after cancellation, terminal, and zero-buffer checks and is latched for one application read call.
Verify receive_credit_publication remains legacy_current and the batched-credit decision is unchanged.
Verify lifecycle, missing, stale, saturated, contradictory, invalid, and out-of-domain inputs fall back to legacy_current even under single_segment forcing.
Verify simultaneous behavior-distinct forcing of any adjacent adaptive axis is rejected.

Verify force-legacy rollback restores the full existing contiguous-copy loop and preserves ordering, FIN, reset, close, cancellation, disposal, flow-control, congestion, pacing, recovery, packet, terminal, and ownership authority.
Verify the configured policy snapshot remains in a unified epoch when no productive read is observed.
Verify receive observation, epoch, raw, unified evidence v10, unified raw v10, and manifest v11 schemas.
Verify receive rows remain sample-scoped and join by exact source, connection key, and operation sequence.
Verify missing, duplicate, orphan, and out-of-order raw reads fail semantic validation and attributable aggregates are recomputed.
Run focused package, stream-state, application-read, FIN, reset, cancellation, disposal, close, terminal, flow-control, and ownership tests.
Confirm no performance, campaign, transform, ML, CI, push, active_internal, or production action occurred.
expected_result: receive_delivery_quantum is observable, shadowable, independently forceable, unified-row represented, guarded, and force-legacy rollback tested; single_segment changes only the number of existing contiguous source segments contributing to one legal application read; sample and epoch evidence remains exactly attributable; and no active or performance decision is introduced.
status_summary: Focused implementation verification is clean: the runtime seam, listener callback propagation, unified v10 evidence, raw v1 productive-read stream, schemas, exact joins, 17 axis cases, 92 affected adaptive/package cases, and 61 receive ordering, lifecycle, cancellation, terminal, ownership, and flow-credit cases pass in Release. All four Stage 3 SpecTrace artifacts pass the canonical model and reciprocal trace checks. Measurement and active behavior remain frozen.
